identity: A voiceover (or on-screen statement) carried by cinematic footage of ONE subject who never addresses the camera. Typography builds phrase-by-phrase at the spoken rhythm and settles into a full composed quote; the footage is a mood, not a story. Short (14-18s in corpus), heavily graded, ends on a dimmed frame with logo + handle.

rules.footage: 1-8 shots total; a single human subject seen cinematically (from behind, silhouetted, in rain, at a desk) — never lip-synced to the words

typography.build: words/phrases appear AT the voiceover's pace and STAY, accumulating into the full composed quote by the end
typography.mix: two contrasting faces: a plain sans/serif for connective words + an expressive face (script italic, or huge colored display) for the 3-6 EMOTIONAL keywords
typography.emphasis_placement: keywords land in the frame's empty space (sky, wall, darkness), never on the subject's face

skins.bright-serif: daylight footage, elegant serif + script-italic keywords in white
skins.dark-bw-red: monochrome moody footage, small serif whispers + giant RED display keywords
skins.text-cards: full-black (or white) statement cards alternating with b-roll; payoff section repeats one anchor phrase ('locked in.') centered over every shot

rules.ending: frame dims 20-40%, full quote or final line holds, Instagram logo + handle fade in

capability_notes: Fully expressible today except the accumulate-and-stay text build (add_text events with staggered starts and a common end time reproduce it) and the script-italic display faces (font availability — check worker/fonts).
